source: Clara miss analysis (50 misses across 32 reports) + confidence calibration

Brighton.rule: HEAVY_DRAW_BIAS — Brighton draws in every single miss scenario. Never predict HOME/AWAY at >55% confidence. Strong lean toward DRAW in every Brighton match.

West Ham.rule: HEAVY_DRAW_BIAS — Every West Ham miss is a draw surprise. Even as favourite, West Ham draws. Add strong draw factor.

Manchester Red.rule: HOME_FAVORITE_TRAP — Man Red is the biggest trap in the league. 80% of misses are them losing at home as favourites. When Man Red is home favourite at odds <1.5, DO NOT predict HOME. Consider AWAY or DRAW. When Man Red is away, they win 90% of miss scenarios (they actually win those).

Aston Villa.rule: HOME_FAVORITE_TRAP — Villa loses at home as favourite 83% of miss scenarios. If Villa is home favourite at odds <1.8, be very skeptical of HOME prediction.

Everton.rule: UNRELIABLE — Everton is the most missed team (14 total). Split between draws and home losses. Never trust Everton at any confidence level >60%.

Tottenham.rule: DRAW_SURPRISE — Tottenham draws when we least expect it. Add draw weight for Spurs matches.

Newcastle.rule: DRAW_BROKEN — Newcastle breaks draws (wins when we predict DRAW). Opposite of draw_surprise — they don't draw, they decide.

Crystal Palace.rule: UPSET_SPECIALIST — Palace causes upsets at home against T1 teams (e.g., 3:2 vs Liverpool). When T1 team visits Palace as heavy favourite, add upset discount.

55-70_pct.actual_vs_expected: OVERCALIBRATED — expects 62%, delivers 43.6%. Apply -18% penalty to all predictions in this range

HOME.rule: Lean HOME when evidence is close — strongest prediction type

AWAY.rule: Only predict AWAY at >65% confidence — coin flip otherwise

DRAW.rule: WEAKEST — only predict DRAW at >65% confidence. Historical data shows draws are harder to predict than any other outcome. Prefer to predict a winner with low confidence than DRAW.

actionable_constraints: NEVER predict HOME for Man Red when they are home favourite at odds <1.5 (80% loss rate in miss scenarios)
ADD draw_surprise flag for ALL Brighton and West Ham matches regardless of odds
REDUCE confidence by 18% for any prediction in the 55-70% confidence range (actual accuracy is 43.6%)
LIMIT DRAW predictions to max 3 per matchday (statistically abnormal beyond that)
When H2H heavily favours HOME (>50%) but odds suggest DRAW, trust H2H not odds — H2H HOME override is correct 67% of the time

h2h_derived_rules.rule: Liverpool at Newcastle is the biggest value edge on MD28 — actual win rate 81.8% vs implied 56.7% (+25.1%)
Aston Villa vs London Guns has a 40.8% upset rate — Villa wins this matchup more than any other lower-tier team against a T1 opponent. Do not automatically predict AWAY.
Wolverhampton vs Bournemouth: Wolves best home matchup at 60%. Lean HOME confidently.
Manchester Blue at Fulham: Man Blue wins 78.4% at home vs Fulham. Away data limited but historical dominance suggests confident AWAY.
Chelsea vs Leeds: As T1vT3, Chelsea should dominate. But Leeds' best home matchup is Bournemouth at 50% — their away form is terrible. Confident HOME.

Manchester Red vs Crystal Palace: H2H says Man Red beats Palace 65.5% AWAY and 75.8% at home vs Bournemouth. BUT Man Red is the #1 home favourite trap. The conflict: historical H2H dominance vs recent miss pattern. TIEBREAKER: Palace is an upset specialist (beat Liverpool 3:2). Recommend HOME with -15% confidence penalty.
Everton vs Tottenham: Both teams unreliable. Everton 43% draw_surprise, Tottenham 63% draw_surprise. Expect a draw or unexpected result.
West Ham vs Brighton: Both 100% draw_surprise specialists. T2vT2 matchup. Strongest draw signal in the entire MD.
